about_the_game:
Shoot 'em up!

Level up your fire power by grabbing power ups to unlock 11 weapon sets for your front and back guns!

Destroy enemies to help grow and maintain your score multiplier!

Eat food to increase your multiplier and aim for the enemies that give you the most points to help you get extra lives!

Collect gems to charge your super weapon and pulverize your enemies!

Use the super weapon to destroy enemy bullets, to get extra points and to escape from dangerous situations!

Use the super weapon to get invincibility time during the blast!

Controlling Hop:

Use focus mode to slow down the ship to avoid obstacles, fly through tight spaces or to evade enemy bullets!

Packed in:

  • 12 action packed levels, each with a unique boss (sometimes more than 1 per level).

  • 3 different routes to progress to your goal (a fourth route will be available as a free add on).

  • 2 different bonus stages to help you increase your score.

  • Hidden warp zones to skip levels or to switch between routes to help you create your own strategy to get the higher score.

  • Hand drawn pixel art comic style to please your eyes!

  • More than 30 unique tracks created by the renowned singer-songwriter/soundtrack composer Eden Cruz to accompany your adventure.

  • 2 different final bosses!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Shader Model 3
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 800 MB available space

short_description: Blast through enemy invaders in this colorful 2D pixel art hand-drawn arcade style cute 'em up action packed adventure! Choose between two different paths and decide on what is best for you to increase your final high score or find the secret warp zones to advance faster to your final objective!!
